Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\({path:'.env'}\); const {Client}=require\('pg'\); const P='520f99eb-7c84-4919-9f55-8ad4230258b4'; const c=new Client\({connectionString:process.env.POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL}\); c.connect\(\).then\(async\(\)=>{ const w=await c.query\('SELECT count\(*\) FROM \\"Workout\\" WHERE \\"profileId\\"=\\$1',[P]\); const s=await c.query\('SELECT count\(*\) FROM \\"Set\\" WHERE \\"workoutId\\" IN \(SELECT id FROM \\"Workout\\" WHERE \\"profileId\\"=\\$1\)',[P]\); const ex=await c.query\('SELECT id,name,\\"primaryMuscle\\",\\"secondaryMuscles\\",\\"isUnilateral\\",\\"isTimeBased\\" FROM \\"Exercise\\" WHERE name IN \(\\$1,\\$2,\\$3,\\$4,\\$5\)',['Barbell Bench Press','Incline Barbell Bench Press','Kroc Row','Barbell Back Squat','Plank']\); console.log\('workouts',w.rows[0].count,'sets',s.rows[0].count\); console.table\(ex.rows.map\(r=>\({name:r.name,pri:r.primaryMuscle,uni:r.isUnilateral,time:r.isTimeBased,sec:\(r.secondaryMuscles||[]\).join\(','\)}\)\)\); await c.end\(\); }\).catch\(e=>{console.error\(e.message\);process.exit\(1\)}\);")
